items.author: xnetcat
items.title: [GPU] Encode a command buffer's occlusion prefix sums together
items.note:
Silent Hill: The Short Message was ending each render pass that counted occlusion samples with its own one-thread compute encoder for the prefix sum: about 117 extra encoders per frame. A pass that ends now only queues its prefix sum. The queued sums are encoded together, in pass order, in one compute encoder. That happens just before the next label copies land (an occlusion dump's copy reads them) and before the command buffer commits. Batch reuse, counter resets and counter reads all go through those two points, so they still see final sums.
